ideas.title: Following the Money in the Minnesota Fraud Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the flow of money in the Minnesota fraud investigation, including the sources of the funds and the individuals and organizations involved.
questions: What are the sources of the funds involved in the Minnesota fraud investigation?
How are the funds being used?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money will reveal key information about the individuals and organizations involved in the Minnesota fraud investigation. This story has the potential to uncover widespread corruption and fraud.
